ValidationRule.description: Prevents Ops users to edit non competitor Bank Accounts ACH info.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( Account__r.RecordType.Name <> 'Competitor', $Profile.Name = 'FPC - Operations User', OR( ISCHANGED( Bank_Account_Number__c), ISCHANGED( Bank_Name__c), ISCHANGED( Routing_Number__c), ISCHANGED( Payee_s_Name__c), ISCHANGED( Receiving_Company_Name__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can only edit Bank Account records for Competitor Accounts.
